description.zh: 用硬像素边缘、有限色板与点阵字形表示「游戏机记忆」的界面视觉语言。锯齿即正确， 缩放必须整数倍，抖动网点做过渡。刻意站在抗锯齿的对立面。
description.en: Hard pixel edges, a limited palette and bitmap faces as a console-nostalgia interface look. Aliasing is correct, scaling must be integer, dithering does the gradients. Deliberately against anti-aliasing.

use_when.zh: 游戏、独立游戏发行、复古主题产品，风格即世界观
use_when.en: Games, indie releases and retro-themed products where style is worldbuilding

use_when.zh: 想用点阵与有限色制造怀旧亲和，或做游戏化进度反馈
use_when.en: Nostalgic warmth via bitmap and limited color, or gamified progress

use_when.zh: 徽章、成就、状态点等小尺寸图标需要强识别
use_when.en: Badges, achievements and status dots that must read at small size

avoid_when.zh: 长文阅读与高密度表格，点阵字放大后可读性崩坏
avoid_when.en: Long reading and dense tables — bitmap type degrades when scaled

avoid_when.zh: 需要连续渐变、照片展示、平滑动效的场景
avoid_when.en: Continuous gradients, photo galleries and smooth motion

avoid_when.zh: 正式政企金融界面，像素语汇会削弱可信度
avoid_when.en: Formal enterprise and finance UIs where pixels undercut trust

note.zh: NES 式硬边与 3～6 色调色板，黑描边像素块
note.en: NES-style hard edges, 3–6 color palette, black-outlined blocks

note.zh: 高分辨率像素网格，色板更宽，圆角用像素阶梯近似
note.en: Finer pixel grid, wider palette, radii as stepped corners

note.zh: 2:1 等距投影小场景，像 SimCity 小地图
note.en: 2:1 isometric vignettes like a SimCity minimap

task.zh: INSERT COIN 启动 8×8 六色像素画板；方向键移动绘制焦点、空格绘制，也可点击格子；可清空重画，开始、图鉴、商店均有内容，不涉及真实投币。
task.en: INSERT COIN starts an 8×8 six-color pixel board. Move drawing focus with arrows and paint with Space or click cells; clear and redraw. Start, Atlas and Shop reveal content without real coin payments.

checks.zh: 逐一操作 BITMAP 原导航和主 CTA，检查对应内容与返回路径，不只是点击提示。
checks.en: Use BITMAP’s original navigation and primary CTAs; inspect content and return paths, not just click notices.

checks.zh: 完成上述 BITMAP 操作后修改输入或撤销，检查结果与状态同步。
checks.en: Complete the BITMAP task, then change inputs or undo and inspect the matching result/state.

checks.zh: 用键盘和 390px / 320px 检查重排、焦点、校验；区分工具栏重载和内部清空，核对刷新后状态复位。
checks.en: Check reflow, focus and validation with keyboard and 390px / 320px viewports; distinguish toolbar reload from in-page clearing and inspect reset-on-reload boundaries.

css: box-shadow: 多层硬阶梯模拟圆角

notes.zh: 像素感的铁律是整数倍缩放：素材按 1x 设计，展示用 transform: scale(整数) 或 image-rendering: pixelated。 圆角用 box-shadow 多层硬阶梯近似，或直接用直角。过渡渐变用抖动：repeating-conic-gradient 交替两色。 字体用点阵字体（如 Press Start 2P）或等宽体加 letter-spacing 模仿。深色模式换调色板但保持同一网格。
notes.en: Pixel feel hinges on integer scaling: design assets at 1x and present via transform: scale(integer) or image-rendering: pixelated. Approximate radii with multi-layer hard box-shadow steps — or stay square. Fake gradients with dithering: repeating-conic-gradient alternating two colors. Type is a bitmap face (e.g. Press Start 2P) or monospace with letter-spacing. Dark mode swaps the palette but keeps the same grid.

basic.zh: 用像素风（Pixel Art UI）设计界面：硬像素边缘、有限色板、点阵字形、抖动网点过渡，游戏机怀旧感。
basic.en: Design an interface in Pixel Art UI style: hard pixel edges, limited palette, bitmap type and dithered transitions — console nostalgia.

design.zh: 像素风设计规范：调色板锁 6 色内（如 #1A1C2C #5D275D #B13E53 #EF7D57 #FFCD75 #A7F070）； 全部圆角 0；描边 2px 纯黑像素块；按钮用 2px 硬边 + 按下时 2px 位移吃掉描边； 标题点阵字体 16px 整数倍；渐变一律抖动网点；深色模式用同一调色板的暗档。
design.en: "Pixel Art spec: palette locked to 6 colors (e.g. #1A1C2C #5D275D #B13E53 #EF7D57 #FFCD75 #A7F070); zero radii; 2px pure-black pixel outlines; buttons with 2px hard edges that swallow their outline on press via a 2px shift; bitmap headings at integer 16px multiples; all gradients dithered; dark mode uses the dark tier of the same palette."

implementation.zh:
以 /styles/pixel-art/ 为整页入口。标题表达：INTERFACE QUEST；页面气质：用像素，构建你的界面世界。。按最新整页图像提案设计布局、字体、图形、材质与组件；桌面区域构图为 "title title title" "controls art variants" "controls art notes" "prompt prompt prompt"，不能只换颜色。

首页入口固定在左上角，图标加“首页”，点击区域至少 44×44px；手机上不收进菜单。变体只使用 8位复古、现代像素、等距像素，切换同步材质、构图或控件与提示词；保留用户已编辑文字。详情通过原生 dialog 打开，支持 Escape、焦点归还和浏览器前进后退。保留收藏、语言切换、风格指南与可编辑提示词；复制失败选中文本供手动复制。当前风格过渡基准 120ms，减少动态效果时取消动画。桌面、390px、320px 按内容重排。

实现入口为 src/components/atlas/AtlasPage.astro；逐风格顺序在 src/lib/atlas-designs.ts；交互在 src/lib/atlas-runtime.ts；整页样式在 src/styles/atlas-pages.css。既有 /style-scenes/ 独立案例保留，但不要重新嵌入详情页。
implementation.en:
Build the full /en/styles/pixel-art/ page. Display direction: INTERFACE QUEST; Build your interface, pixel by pixel.. Follow the latest whole-page image proposal for layout, typography, artwork, materials and components. Desktop grid areas: "title title title" "controls art variants" "controls art notes" "prompt prompt prompt". Do not just recolour a template.

Keep an icon plus Home link fixed at the top left, at least 44×44px, visible on mobile without opening a menu. Variants: 8-bit retro, Modern pixel, Isometric pixel. Update the design and prompt without overwriting manual edits. Native dialogs support Escape, focus return and browser Back/Forward. Preserve saves, locale switching, style guide and editable prompts; select text for manual copy when clipboard access fails. Base transition: 120ms, disabled with reduced motion. Reflow at desktop, 390px and 320px.

Use AtlasPage.astro, atlas-designs.ts, atlas-runtime.ts and atlas-pages.css. Keep the legacy /style-scenes/ examples separate; do not embed them into the detail page.

typography.zh: 点阵字体或等宽体，字号整数倍
typography.en: Bitmap or monospace face at integer sizes

color.zh: 6 色以内的有限调色板，高对比硬切
color.en: A palette of six colors or fewer, hard high-contrast cuts

shadow.zh: 硬偏移像素块投影，无模糊
shadow.en: Hard offset pixel-block shadows, no blur

spacing.zh: 8px 网格对齐，元素贴像素格
spacing.en: 8px grid alignment, elements snapped to the pixel lattice

motion.zh: 无补间，步进式的瞬时切换

states.zh: hover 换用高亮像素色；focus 用 2px 像素可见描边；active 位移一个像素块；disabled 降为两档灰；error 用红像素块
states.en: Hover switches to a highlight pixel colour; focus shows a visible 2px pixel outline; active shifts by one pixel block; disabled drops to two greys; error uses a red pixel block

keywords.zh: 硬边 · 点阵 · 有限色

heroSub.zh: 整数倍缩放，锯齿即正确。
heroSub.en: Scale in whole numbers. Sharp pixels are the point.
